name: Usage
description: Token-usage stats overlay. The /usage command opens an interactive footer overlay showing total tokens + cost across all saved sessions, broken down by provider and model, as ASCII bar charts. Left/Right switch the time window (Today, Last 24h, Last 30d, YTD, Last year, All time); 1-6 jump; Esc closes. Real billed usage is marked [R], transcript-estimated [E]. Same data + renderer as the `usage` CLI command. Headless: /usage <period> prints once to scrollback.
